entries.3f13d4070143c829: This is the domestic site of "Super Delivery," which mainly targets small and medium-sized retail stores in Japan. Member retail stores can choose between a free plan and a Standard Plan, which charges a monthly fee and offers benefits such as points based on purchase amounts. The company has now expanded its target to include businesses in Japan outside the retail sector and overseas businesses with receiving bases in Japan. Revenue is disclosed only for the EC Business, and no amount for this category alone is printed.

entries.5fa73f836469be7f: A receivables guarantee service under which, when accounts receivable arising from transactions between businesses remain uncollected, the company pays a guarantee amount on behalf of the counterparty up to a preset payment limit. The entire process, from application through credit screening to guarantee claims, is completed online, and under a fixed-fee system, guarantees can be applied to any number of companies within the plan's limit. Revenue for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥1,563 million.
entries.703b0031cf14638f: A BtoB deferred payment settlement service that handles everything from issuing invoices to collecting payment for transactions between businesses. It covers credit management through to collection work, and because the company pays the amount even when non-payment occurs, selling companies can offer credit sales from the first transaction. Revenue for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥1,110 million.

entries.80b7fa815f9c0c43: This is the Group’s reportable segment that operates “Sūpā Deribarī,” a business-to-business (BtoB) site handling apparel and general merchandise. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥3,899 million. It is operated by consolidated subsidiary Rakūn Komāsu Co., Ltd. It is a shopping mall-style site in which member companies purchase products that exhibitor companies list on the site, and exhibitor companies can expand their sales channels while using a mechanism that avoids the credit risk of small and medium-sized retail stores.

entries.ed0262ec91c481ec: This is the overseas site of "Super Delivery." Because the company group acts as the exporter, exhibiting companies can sell to retail stores and companies overseas simply by shipping products to designated warehouses, without carrying out export procedures themselves. Only the Free Plan is offered, with no monthly fee; exhibiting companies pay a system usage fee based on distribution value. Revenue is disclosed only for the EC Business, and no amount for this category alone is printed.
